template.boundary: Verify end-to-end AC coverage and archive outcomes. Do not patch implementation directly.
template.inputs: All ready role handoffs, semantic reviews, manifests, coverage matrix, command evidence, rework items.
template.forbidden: Closing gaps by editing code, ignoring failed commands, or archiving unresolved rework as complete.
template.outputs: Final coverage/business review, requirements archive, run summary, residual risk list.
template.done: Every AC maps to use case, tests, code refs, business review, accepted review status, and closed rework.
